# Track Blood

> Track Blood is a free, local-first blood report tracker for iOS, Android, and web. Upload PDF blood test reports, see every marker's trend over time, journal health notes, and set reminders — with no login, no account, and no server: all data stays on the user's own device.

Track Blood parses PDF blood test reports (from Aarthi Scans, Centro Med, Innoquest (SG), Metropolis, Neuberg Anand, Orange Health, Tata 1mg, Thyrocare, and other labs) and recognizes 150+ distinct markers and their aliases, regardless of how a given lab names or formats a test. Extraction happens entirely on-device (in the browser for the web version, in-app for iOS/Android) — no report or health data is ever uploaded to a server.

## Key facts

- No login or account required; there is no user database or authentication of any kind.
- All extracted data (marker values, trends, journal notes, reminders) is stored locally on the user's own device.
- HIPAA compliance doesn't apply in the traditional sense, since the app never transmits or stores health data server-side — there is no server-side record to be compliant (or non-compliant) about.
- Free on all platforms, no ads, no in-app purchases.
- Available as a website (no install needed), and as native iOS and Android apps (which add journaling and reminders on top of report tracking).
- Users can export a consolidated CSV or PDF of all their markers across every report date, e.g. to share with a doctor or paste into an AI assistant for a second opinion on trends.

## Pages

- [Track Blood](https://track-blood.pocha.fyi/): main site — upload a report, browse features, FAQ, and download links for iOS/Android.
